title: Catalog commercial contract v2
description: Interchange reference. The executable source of truth is src/domain/catalog/v2/contracts.ts; fixtures/ are generated from the real service and pinned by fixtures/MANIFEST.json.

identity.productKey: PRODUCT identity: search results, product context, frequentlyBoughtTogether items, variant_required answers. Never a sellable item when the product has variants.
identity.itemKey: SELLABLE ITEM identity: only facts.sellableItem, facts.variantOptions[] and the item context emit it. P{id} only for a product without variants; P{id}-V{variantId} for a variant.

validUntil.description: Until when the owner vouches for the answer (OD-3): asOf + 15 s, or earlier at the first scheduled price change (an applied promotion ending or a compatible one starting). A cached answer is never served after it.

priceSummary.description: OD-1. kind exact = product without variants; from = minimum over variants. basis offerable = only units orderable now (sellable or backorder) set it, a unit that cannot be ordered never lowers it; basis not_offerable = explicit fallback when no priced unit is offerable (reference price, not an offer).

promotion.description: OD-2. Present only when it lowers the price. Normalized: consumers never see PrestaShop reduction_tax. regularGross is the price before the reduction (a fixed-price override is part of it). Display-only; finalGross is the owner's price.

category.description: J1D-CAT-02. The product's meaningful category: an audited SEMANTIC_STRONG/SEMANTIC_WEAK category it is assigned to (strongest, deepest, lowest id). Never the navigation root (CATEGORÍAS), a campaign, legacy or test category; null when none qualifies.

textBounds.description: name/category/attribute/feature name 1..128, sku 1..64, brand 1..64, feature value 1..255, shortDescription <= 600, specifications <= 40, variantOptions <= 100, variant attributes <= 10.

failureSemantics.notFound: An unknown key is a 200 answer (status not_found), never an HTTP 404.

search: J1D-CAT-01. Nominal lexical search: exact reference, exact name, phrase in name, every significant word/measure in the name, then in the short description. Measures match exactly (10 kg never matches 110 kg); explicit equivalences only: case, accents, unit spellings, singular/plural. No conceptual expansion.
additiveEvolution: schemaVersion changes only on a breaking change. New optional fields may be added within schemaVersion 1; consumers must tolerate unknown fields and reject missing or mistyped known ones.
versionHistory: schemaVersion 1 is frozen at its first production deployment (R4-J1D). The pre-production J1C shape (promotion.discountType/discountValue, priceSummary without basis) was never deployed and is superseded, not versioned; engineVersion catalog-commercial-v2.1.0 identifies the J1D semantics.
